name: Gabon

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and blue.
flag.symbolism: Green represents the forests, yellow the equator and the sun, and blue the sea.

hook: Gabon stacks green forest, yellow equator and blue ocean, and the equator really does run through the country; Sierra Leone has white in the middle.
trivia: The equator crosses Gabon, just as the yellow stripe crosses the middle of its flag.
Libreville, 'free town', was founded in 1849 by people freed from a slave ship.
